description: Overall rhythm of play. Drives session length, scene density, tension curve, time pressure. Picked first — every other axis reads it.
prompt_template:
Given this style guide:
{style_guide}

Generate {count} pacing approaches covering:
- Session length target: 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min+, episodic
- Scene density: sparse_exploration, balanced, dense_minigames, story_heavy
- Tension curve: flat, rising, episodic_waves, freeform
- Time pressure: never, contextual, omnipresent

Each option must be distinct from the others by at least two of the above dimensions.
Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the pacing option below per the user feedback. Stay within option_schema. Adjust session_target_min, scene_density, tension_curve, time_pressure, or recommended counts as needed.
